title: CBSE CLASS 5 — English | Precis Writing
description: Subject-wise test on Precis Writing (English) for CBSE CLASS 5. 50Q.
subject: cbse5-english

questions.question: What is the main purpose of writing a summary of a story or passage?

options.text: To make the story longer with more details.
options.explanation: A summary should be concise, not longer or more detailed.

options.text: To retell the story using difficult words.
options.explanation: A summary should use simple and clear language, not difficult words.

options.text: To present the main ideas in a shorter form.
options.explanation: This is the correct purpose of a summary.

options.text: To copy the story exactly as it is.
options.explanation: A summary should not copy the story exactly; it should shorten and simplify it.

questions.explanation: The main purpose of summarizing is to capture the core information or main ideas of a text in a more concise and shorter format, making it easier to understand quickly.
questions.hint: A summary should be shorter and focus on the key points.
questions.subject: cbse5-english

questions.question: Which option best tells the main idea of this sentence in fewer words? 'The little bird flew high into the sky and sang a sweet song.'

options.text: The bird flew.
options.explanation: This option misses the action of singing.

options.text: The bird sang a song.
options.explanation: This option misses the action of flying high into the sky.

options.text: A bird flew high and sang.
options.explanation: This option misses the detail 'little' and 'sweet song'.

options.text: The little bird flew and sang.
options.explanation: This option includes both key actions and the detail 'little'.

questions.explanation: Option D captures both key actions (flying and singing) of the little bird, making it the most accurate short summary of the original sentence without losing significant meaning.
questions.hint: Look for the sentence that includes both actions mentioned in the original.
questions.subject: cbse5-english

questions.question: Which sentence is not important if you want to summarize what Fluffy the cat does? 'My cat, Fluffy, loves to play. She chases toys, climbs on furniture, and often sleeps on my bed. My dog's name is Buddy.'

options.text: My cat, Fluffy, loves to play.
options.explanation: This sentence describes Fluffy's actions.

options.text: She chases toys, climbs on furniture.
options.explanation: This sentence describes Fluffy's actions.

options.text: My dog's name is Buddy.
options.explanation: This sentence is about a different pet and is not relevant to Fluffy.

options.text: She often sleeps on my bed.
options.explanation: This sentence describes Fluffy's actions.

questions.explanation: The question asks to summarize what Fluffy the cat does. The sentence 'My dog's name is Buddy' talks about a different pet and is not relevant to Fluffy's actions or habits.
questions.hint: Focus on the sentences that describe Fluffy's actions.
questions.subject: cbse5-english

questions.question: What would be the best title for a summary of this paragraph? 'Rohan loves to read books. He visits the library every week and always has a new story to tell his friends. His favourite books are about space and dinosaurs.'

options.text: Rohan's Library
options.explanation: This title is too specific and only mentions the library.

options.text: Rohan's Favourite Books
options.explanation: This title is too specific and only mentions his favorite books.

options.text: Rohan the Reader
options.explanation: This title captures Rohan's overall hobby of reading.

options.text: Books about Space
options.explanation: This title is too specific and only mentions one type of book.

questions.explanation: 'Rohan the Reader' is the most comprehensive title as it captures Rohan's overall hobby and interest in reading, which is the main theme of the paragraph. The other options are too specific or don't cover the full scope.
questions.hint: Look for a title that covers Rohan's main activity mentioned in the paragraph.
questions.subject: cbse5-english

questions.question: Which sentence best summarizes Maya's morning routine? 'Every morning, Maya eats a healthy breakfast of fruits and milk. She then brushes her teeth and packs her school bag. After that, she puts on her uniform and waits for her school bus.'

options.text: Maya eats fruits and milk for breakfast.
options.explanation: This sentence only mentions one part of Maya's routine.

options.text: Maya gets ready for school every morning.
options.explanation: This sentence includes all the actions as part of a larger routine.

options.text: Maya waits for her school bus.
options.explanation: This sentence only mentions one part of Maya's routine.

options.text: Maya brushes her teeth and packs her bag.
options.explanation: This sentence misses some parts of Maya's routine.

questions.explanation: Option B encompasses all the actions mentioned (eating breakfast, brushing teeth, packing bag, putting on uniform, waiting for bus) as part of a larger routine of 'getting ready for school,' making it the most accurate and concise summary.
questions.hint: Look for a sentence that includes all the key actions in Maya's routine.
questions.subject: cbse5-english

questions.question: What is the most important message the teacher wants to give? 'Always remember to be kind to everyone, even if they are different from you. A small act of kindness can make a big difference.'

options.text: Students should be different.
options.explanation: This is not the main message; the teacher encourages kindness, not differences.

options.text: It is important to be kind to others.
options.explanation: This is the main message emphasized by the teacher.

options.text: Teachers like kind students.
options.explanation: This is not mentioned in the teacher's statement.

options.text: Small acts are not important.
options.explanation: The teacher states that small acts of kindness can make a big difference.

questions.explanation: The teacher's main message is directly stated and emphasized: 'Always remember to be kind to everyone' and 'A small act of kindness'.
questions.hint: Focus on the repeated emphasis in the teacher's statement.

questions.question: Which of the following best defines a précis?

options.text: A detailed summary of a passage with all examples
options.explanation: A précis is not a detailed summary.

options.text: A short, clear, and concise summary of a passage in your own words
options.explanation: This is the correct definition of a précis.

options.text: A paraphrase of the original passage using synonyms only
options.explanation: A précis is not just a paraphrase using synonyms.

options.text: A retelling of the passage in the form of a story
options.explanation: A précis is not a retelling in story form.

questions.explanation: A précis is a short, clear, and concise summary of a passage written in your own words. It should capture the main idea without including all details or examples.
questions.hint: A précis is not a detailed summary or a paraphrase using synonyms only.
questions.subject: cbse5-english

questions.question: How long should a précis usually be in comparison to the original passage?

options.explanation: A précis is shorter than half the length.

options.text: About one-third the length of the original
options.explanation: This is the correct length for a précis.

options.text: The same length as the original
options.explanation: A précis is not the same length as the original.

options.text: Twice as long as the original
options.explanation: A précis is shorter than the original.

questions.explanation: A précis is typically about one-third the length of the original passage. It condenses the main points while retaining the essential meaning.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a feature of a good précis?

options.text: It should be in the third person
options.explanation: A précis is usually written in the third person.

options.text: It should include the writer’s personal opinions
options.explanation: A précis should not include personal opinions.

options.text: It should be written in simple and clear language
options.explanation: A précis should be written in simple and clear language.

options.text: It should retain the original meaning of the passage
options.explanation: A précis should retain the original meaning.

questions.explanation: A précis should not include the writer’s personal opinions. It must remain objective and focus only on the main ideas of the original passage.

questions.question: Read the passage below and choose the correct précis: *Passage:* 'The water cycle is a continuous process by which water moves from the Earth's surface to the atmosphere and back again. It starts with evaporation, where water turns into vapor and rises into the air. Next, condensation occurs, forming clouds. Finally, precipitation happens when the water falls back to Earth as rain, snow, or hail.'

options.text: Water cycle is a process where water moves from Earth to the atmosphere and back through evaporation, condensation, and precipitation
options.explanation: This is the correct précis.

options.text: The water cycle involves water turning into vapor, forming clouds, and falling as rain
options.explanation: This is incomplete.

options.text: Water evaporates, condenses to form clouds, and then precipitates back to Earth
options.explanation: This is a paraphrase, not a précis.

options.text: Both A and C
options.explanation: Only A is correct.

questions.explanation: Option A correctly summarizes the main idea of the passage in a concise manner, highlighting the key stages of the water cycle. Option B is incomplete, and Option C is a paraphrase, not a précis.
questions.hint: A précis should capture the main idea without including all details or examples.
questions.subject: cbse5-english

questions.question: Assertion (A): A précis must include all the minor details of the original passage. Reason (R): A précis is a detailed summary that aims to cover every point mentioned in the original passage.

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
options.explanation: Both A and R are false.

options.text: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
options.explanation: Both A and R are false.

options.text: A is true, but R is false
options.explanation: A is false, and R is false.

options.text: A is false, but R is true
options.explanation: Both A and R are false.

questions.explanation: A précis does not include all minor details; it focuses only on the main ideas. Therefore, Assertion A is false, while Reason R is also false because a précis is not a detailed summary covering every point.
questions.hint: A précis is concise and does not include all minor details.
questions.subject: cbse5-english

questions.question: Which of the following steps should you follow FIRST when writing a précis?

options.text: Writing the précis in your own words
options.explanation: This is not the first step.

options.text: Counting the number of words in the original passage
options.explanation: This is not the first step.

options.text: Highlighting every detail in the passage

questions.question: A student writes the following précis for a passage about the benefits of trees: 'Trees give us oxygen, shade, and fruits. They also help birds and animals live.' Which feature of a good précis is missing in this summary?

options.explanation: The précis is objective.

options.text: Conciseness

options.text: Completeness
options.explanation: The précis is missing completeness.

options.text: Clarity
options.explanation: The précis is clear.

questions.question: Case-Based: *Passage:* 'The Taj Mahal is one of the most beautiful buildings in the world. It was built by Emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal. Made of white marble, it took 22 years to complete and attracts millions of visitors every year.' Which of the following is the BEST précis of the passage?

options.text: The Taj Mahal is a beautiful white marble building built by Shah Jahan for his wife Mumtaz Mahal. It took 22 years to complete and is visited by many people
options.explanation: This is the best précis.

options.text: The Taj Mahal is a famous monument made of white marble
options.explanation: This is incomplete.

options.text: The Taj Mahal was built by Shah Jahan in memory of his wife. It is a popular tourist spot
options.explanation: This is incomplete.

options.text: The Taj Mahal is a beautiful building made of white marble. It was built in 22 years and attracts many visitors
options.explanation: This is incomplete.

questions.explanation: Option A is the best précis because it includes all the main points: the builder (Shah Jahan), the reason (memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal), the material (white marble), the time taken (22 years), and its popularity (visited by many).
questions.hint: A good précis should include all the main points of the original passage.
questions.subject: cbse5-english

options.explanation: This is essential for a précis.

options.text: Examples or illustrations given in the passage.
options.explanation: A précis should omit examples to keep it concise.

options.text: The conclusion of the passage.
options.explanation: This is often part of the main idea.

options.text: The key points of the passage.
options.explanation: This is essential for a précis.

questions.explanation: A précis should omit examples or illustrations to keep it concise and focused on the main ideas.
questions.hint: A précis should focus on key points, not extra details.
questions.subject: cbse5-english

questions.question: Read the passage and choose the best précis: 'A stitch in time saves nine. This means that if you fix a small problem early, it will save you from bigger trouble later. For example, if you repair a small hole in your clothes now, it will prevent the need for a bigger repair later.'

options.text: Fixing small problems early saves you from bigger trouble later.
options.explanation: This option captures the main idea concisely.

options.text: A stitch in time saves nine.
options.explanation: Too vague and lacks explanation.

options.text: Repairing clothes early is better than repairing them later.
options.explanation: Too specific and misses the broader meaning.

options.text: The proverb means that small problems should be fixed early.
options.explanation: Too close to the original and not concise enough.

questions.explanation: Option A correctly condenses the passage by explaining the meaning of the proverb without including the example.
questions.hint: Look for the option that captures the main idea without extra details.
questions.subject: cbse5-english

questions.question: What is the main purpose of writing a précis?

options.text: To add more details to the original passage
options.explanation: A précis should summarize, not add details.

options.text: To summarize the main idea in fewer words while keeping the essence
options.explanation: This is the correct purpose of a précis.

options.text: To rewrite the passage in a different language
options.explanation: A précis is not a translation.

options.text: To explain the meaning of difficult words in the passage
options.explanation: A précis focuses on summarizing, not explaining words.

questions.explanation: A précis is a concise summary of a passage that retains its main ideas and essential points while reducing its length.
questions.hint: A précis should be shorter and capture the essence of the original passage.
questions.subject: cbse5-english

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a feature of a good précis?

options.text: It should be shorter than the original passage
options.explanation: A précis is always shorter than the original.

options.text: It should include the writer’s personal opinions
options.explanation: A précis must be objective and avoid personal opinions.

options.text: It should maintain the original meaning
options.explanation: A précis must retain the original meaning.

options.text: It should be written in the third person
options.explanation: A précis is typically written in the third person.

questions.explanation: A précis should be objective and avoid personal opinions or biases.
questions.hint: A good précis should be neutral and not include personal views.

questions.question: Read the passage below and choose the correct précis: *Original Passage:* 'The Taj Mahal is one of the most beautiful buildings in the world. It was built by Emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal. Made of white marble, it stands on the banks of the Yamuna River in Agra.'

options.text: The Taj Mahal is a beautiful building built by Shah Jahan for his wife.
options.explanation: This option correctly summarizes the main idea and key details.

options.text: The Taj Mahal is a temple made of white marble.
options.explanation: This option misses key details like who built it and why.

options.text: The Taj Mahal is located near the Ganga River.
options.explanation: The passage mentions the Yamuna River, not the Ganga.

options.text: The Taj Mahal was built by Mumtaz Mahal.
options.explanation: The Taj Mahal was built by Shah Jahan, not Mumtaz Mahal.

questions.explanation: The précis retains the main idea (beauty of the Taj Mahal) and key details (built by Shah Jahan, for his wife, made of white marble).
questions.hint: Look for a summary that includes the main subject and key details without adding new information.
questions.subject: cbse5-english

questions.question: Assertion (A): A précis must include all the details from the original passage. Reason (R): A précis is a shorter version of the original, so it cannot include all details.

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.explanation: A is false, so this option is incorrect.

options.text: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
options.explanation: A is false, so this option is incorrect.

options.text: A is true, but R is false.
options.explanation: A is false, so this option is incorrect.

options.text: A is false, but R is true.
options.explanation: A is false because a précis does not include all details, and R is true because it explains why.

questions.hint: Consider whether a précis needs every single detail from the original passage.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is a good précis for the given statement? *Statement:* 'The Amazon rainforest is the largest tropical rainforest in the world. It covers most of the Amazon basin of South America and is home to millions of species of plants and animals.'

options.text: The Amazon rainforest is large and has many species.
options.explanation: This option correctly summarizes the main idea and key details.

options.text: The Amazon rainforest is in South America.
options.explanation: This option misses key details like its size and biodiversity.

options.text: The Amazon rainforest is the smallest rainforest.
options.explanation: This contradicts the original statement.

options.text: The Amazon rainforest has no plants or animals.
options.explanation: This contradicts the original statement.

questions.explanation: The précis captures the main idea (size and biodiversity of the Amazon rainforest) concisely.
questions.hint: Look for a summary that includes the main subject and key details without adding new information.

questions.question: Read the following passage and choose the best précis from the options: 'The Taj Mahal is one of the most beautiful buildings in the world. It was built by Emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal. Made of white marble, it took 22 years and thousands of workers to complete. The Taj Mahal is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and attracts millions of visitors every year.'

options.text: The Taj Mahal is a beautiful building made by Emperor Shah Jahan for his wife. It took 22 years to build and is now a famous tourist spot.
options.explanation: This option includes all key details in a concise form.

options.text: The Taj Mahal is a white marble building built by Shah Jahan. It was completed after 22 years.
options.explanation: This option misses the reason for its construction and its current status.

options.text: The Taj Mahal is a famous monument built by Shah Jahan. It is made of marble and attracts many visitors.
options.explanation: This option misses the time taken to build and the reason for its construction.

options.text: The Taj Mahal is a beautiful structure built in memory of Mumtaz Mahal. It is a World Heritage Site.
options.explanation: This option misses the material, time taken, and the fact that it attracts visitors.

questions.explanation: Option A correctly summarizes the main points — who built it, why, how long it took, and its current status — in a concise manner.
questions.hint: Look for the option that includes all key details in a shorter form.
questions.subject: cbse5-english

questions.question: Given the following passage, which précis is grammatically incorrect and changes the meaning? 'Scientists have discovered a new species of frog in the Amazon rainforest. This frog is bright blue in color and is about 2 cm long. It lives near streams and feeds on small insects. The discovery was made by a team of researchers from Brazil.'

options.text: A new species of bright blue frog, just 2 cm long, was found in the Amazon rainforest by Brazilian scientists.
options.explanation: This option is grammatically correct and retains the original meaning.

options.text: Near Amazon streams, a tiny 2 cm long bright blue frog that eats insects was discovered by scientists.
options.explanation: This option is grammatically correct and retains the original meaning.

options.text: Scientists from Brazil discovered a new species of frog in the Amazon that is bright blue and feeds on insects, but it is not 2 cm long.
options.explanation: This option incorrectly states the size of the frog, changing the original meaning.

options.text: A team of Brazilian researchers found a small bright blue frog near Amazon streams that feeds on insects.
options.explanation: This option is grammatically correct and retains the original meaning.

questions.explanation: Option C is incorrect because it changes the size of the frog (2 cm) by stating it is 'not 2 cm long,' which alters the original meaning and is not a valid précis.
questions.hint: Look for the option that incorrectly states a detail from the original passage.
questions.subject: cbse5-english
